title: Transport of the K-flat square through the intrinsic realization
statement: For K-flat finite coefficient complexes P,Q with K-flat intrinsic pullbacks, the ordinary K-flat tensor square transports along the prescribed degreewise finite realization to the intrinsic derived tensor square, with exactly the prescribed finite tensor models and the chain map finitePullbackTensorChainIso. This statement is the derived representative square only; the independent unit-generator equation is supplied separately.

source.place: Tag 07A4, proof of lemma-pullback-tensor-product; Tag 06YS for K-flat resolutions; ordinary sheaf tensor pullback in modules on sites, Tag 03EL.

proof.text: The realization is a chain isomorphism. Tensoring that isomorphism with every acyclic complex transfers the assumed intrinsic pullback K-flatness to the ordinary pullbacks. Apply the ordinary K-flat representative square.

Naturality of the specified finite tensor model moves the localized realization maps through the target model. The derived realization factorization formula identifies each intrinsic factor with its ordinary factor followed by the localized realization. Postcompose the ordinary square, use these two identities, and reassociate; the resulting chain map is the conjugate defining finitePullbackTensorChainIso.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePullbackTensor_intrinsic_kflat_square {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] (n : ℕ)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P)
    (hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) Q)
    (hFP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
      (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (hFQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
      (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) :
    (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
        ((finiteIntrinsicTensorModels l E Y n).iso (ProEt.topology Y)
          (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) (finiteIntrinsicClosed l E Y n)
          P Q hP hQ).hom ≫
      ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)).hom ≫
      (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map
        (Prod.mkHom
          ((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))
            f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P)
          ((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))
            f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q)) =
    (sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))
      f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app _ ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (finitePullbackTensorChainIso l E f n P Q).hom ≫
      ((finiteIntrinsicTensorModels l E X n).iso (ProEt.topology X)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n) (finiteIntrinsicClosed l E X n)
        _ _ hFP hFQ).hom
